body:
Reported: the log-workout day list didn't agree with the circular picker.

Two separate causes.

**1. The picker was missing a day.** It filtered out the current day, on the
reasoning that the "Use Next" card above it already covers today. That left 11
of 12 entries, so every item below today's slot sat one position off from its
day number — the list no longer lined up with the dial's twelve.

It now lists all 12 in cycle order as `Day 5 · Compound: Pulls`, with `(today)`
marking the current one. Standard rule: annotate, don't remove — dropping an
item from an ordered set the user already has a spatial model of silently shifts
everything after it.

The default also moves from "first day that isn't today" to the current day, so
flipping the toggle doesn't change what the card below is showing. That fixes a
latent bug too: the old default was computed once at mount from a `currentDay`
that arrives asynchronously, so it could be stale.

**2. The dial spoke a different vocabulary.** It rendered `DAY_DESIGN.group`, a
short muscle-label list used in exactly one place, while every other surface
renders `DAY_CONFIG.name`:

| Day | Everywhere else | Dial (before) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Compound: Legs | QUADS |
| 3 | Hamstrings | POST. CHAIN |
| 5 | Compound: Pulls | BACK |
| 7 | Torso | TRAPS |
| 8 | Pecs (Mobility) | PECS |
| 9 | Compound: Push | PECS |
| 12 | Grip | FOREARM |

Only days 2 and 10 matched exactly, and 8 and 9 were indistinguishable — the one
distinction the cycle most needs visible, since dips belong on 9 and never on 8.

The dial now renders `DAY_CONFIG.name`; `group` and `dayGroup()` are deleted.
Long names drop 9px → 8px: "COMPOUND: PULLS" measures 87.1 units at 9px against
~90 units of clear space inside the ring, which fit but would have kissed the
ring edge.

## Verification

`npm run build` clean. Checked in the running app with `currentDay = 5`: the
picker's options read Day 1 through Day 12 in order with `(today)` on day 5 and
the select's value at 5, and the dial caption reads COMPOUND: PULLS, measured at
77.4 units — inside the hole, no overlap.

Not addressed here: the drawer's day title renders red for every day, because
`index.css` remaps `.text-cyan-300` to `--muscle-red` while the dial uses each
day's own accent. Separate fix.
title: fix: make the day picker and cycle dial agree
